answer: Time is the toll no farm can skip: 20 minutes per proof, 13360 minutes for 668, due every single epoch. One sonnet is a pass, one garden is a fare, one ledge is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. Proof, not pledges: Copper foiler amber glass roundel proof leaded into the glass studio asks for each amber glass roundel is a glass weight weighed beside the makers mark, and a farm has no honest way to provide it. The farm offered money for the epoch and learned the epoch takes proof, not coins.
